description: This Java class provides utility methods for testing dialogs in the AnySoftKeyboard project, including retrieving the latest shown dialog and extracting dialog titles, utilizing Robolectric and Mockito for testing.

classes.name: GeneralDialogTestUtil
classes.description: Utility class for testing dialog-related functionalities in the context of Android UI testing with Robolectric and Mockito.

methods.name: getLatestShownDialog
methods.description: Retrieves the most recently shown AlertDialog that matches specific criteria, using Robolectric shadows and RxJava for asynchronous handling.

methods.name: getTitleFromDialog
methods.description: Extracts the title text from a given Dialog, handling both AlertDialog instances and other Dialog types via Robolectric shadows.
